title: Vote share cutoff and policy adoption
research_question: Does winning a ballot initiative (vote share ≥ 50%) cause a discontinuous jump in municipal spending on the targeted policy?
data_description: Cross-sectional data on 600 ballot initiatives. Variables: running_var (vote share, 0–1), treated (1 if vote_share ≥ 0.5), y (log municipal spending change), near_cutoff (|running_var − 0.5| ≤ 0.3). Sharp RDD: all initiatives above 50% are adopted.
